model.shadow.review.signed-receipt-exact: The stacked v0.1 signed-review leaf rebuilds detached Ed25519 evidence under a caller-supplied unauthenticated policy.

model.shadow.review.challenge-explicit-c: The exact phrase CONSUME SIGNED REVIEW CHALLENGE ONCE is required before any ledger directory or entry write.

model.shadow.review.challenge-ledger-id-: A create-once, file-synced manifest binds one caller ledger id to the state root; the id and root authenticate no host.

model.shadow.review.challenge-exclusive-: One append-only file per challenge digest is created with filesystem wx semantics and file fsync.
model.shadow.review.challenge-replay-ref: An existing valid entry refuses replay only while the caller-owned ledger state is preserved.

model.shadow.review.challenge-fresh-proc: A second Node process reloads the same state root and receives CHALLENGE_ALREADY_CONSUMED in the synthetic filesystem test.

model.shadow.review.challenge-concurrent: Two concurrent Node processes produce exactly one exclusive-create winner and one typed replay loser for the same challenge in the synthetic test.

model.shadow.review.challenge-corruption: Corrupt JSON, strict truth-boundary tampering, missing manifests with existing state, and conflicting ledger ids block reuse and require steward repair.

model.shadow.review.execution-authority-: Challenge consumption grants no provider, experiment, evaluation, adoption, promotion, merge, Foundation, or CANON authority.

model.shadow.review.challenge-consumptio: The bounded consumption receipt rebuilds from the exact signed-review input, receipt, caller ledger id, confirmation, and caller time.

model.shadow.review.challenge-deletion-r: The selftest demonstrates that deleting the caller-owned namespace reopens the same challenge; no protected storage is claimed.

model.shadow.review.challenge-global-sin: The selftest demonstrates that the same challenge can be consumed in a different state root.

model.shadow.review.host-trust-anchor.ac: No Mike- or host-provisioned reviewer trust root or host authorization service was supplied or inspected.

model.shadow.challenger.human-review.act: Only generated Ed25519 keys and synthetic approvals were used; no real person reviewed a current plan.

model.shadow.challenger.shadow-execution: No model provider or shadow experiment was invoked.
model.shadow.challenger.evaluation.actua: No current baseline/challenger evaluation was executed or supplied.
model.shadow.challenger.human-benefit.he: No voluntary held-out human outcome was observed.
